scope.basis: Initial documented selection of road pieces and track-mounted accessories.
scope.availability: Historical and current products are mixed; catalogue inclusion does not imply current availability.

unresolved: The catalogue dimensions road edges, not slot centres. This nominal model assumes two centred slots 90 mm apart in the 180 mm road. Per-lane lengths remain estimates until independently measured.
This first selection follows the 1968–1969 catalogue. Later products, including 3123 lane crossover, 3124 hump, 3125 looping and 3154 banked bowl, are outside this pack.
Electrical connection housings, junction, chicane, banking and accessories remain reference-only; complete route and attachment geometry is unresolved.
